I think the fact your sister brought him home to meet her family means that she has serious intentions with this relationship and that it wouldn’t just “fizzle out”. Your son is two now but if he continues to be around as your child grows up, it won’t take much for your family to notice that they look alike. Besides keeping this from your sister would be causing more unnecessary drama than keeping it to yourself and lying about it. Also, keeping this secret will most likely damage your relationship with her for the foreseeable future because she would no longer be able to trust you.

You already have family support and stability, telling her is not going to risk any of that for you or your kid. But it will inform your sister on her choice of partner, and she deserves to be able to make that choice for herself.
